# `Clone`

`Clone` is explicit duplication: [`x.clone()` returns another owned value of the same type and the caller keeps the
original](#spec.ownership.clone.legality-1). Calling `clone` is always explicit; the implicit copy of a [`Copy`](copy.md) type is the `Clone` the compiler
provides, done implicitly.

A type gets a `Clone` by writing one (`extend T: Clone .{ .. }`), by deriving it (`struct P derives Clone .{ .. }`,
which clones each field through that field's own `clone`), or, for a `Copy` type, because the compiler provides it.
A type with none of these has no `Clone`: whether a named type may be duplicated is a statement about what it means, not
a consequence of its fields.

| Kind | `Clone` |
|---|---|
| integers, floats, `boolean`, `Char`, the unit type | the copy |
| `String`, `Option<T>`, `Result<T, E>`, `List<T>` | the standard-library impls, element-wise through each element's `clone` |
| `&T` | for every `T`: another reference |
| `&var T` | never |
| `[T]`, `[T; N]`, records | a view or array copy, and field-wise for records |
| tuples | when every part is, each part through its own `clone`, left to right |
| closures | when `Copy` |
| written function types | never (they are move-only) |

<details>
<summary>Formal rules</summary>

##### Legality Rule {#spec.ownership.clone.legality-1}

`clone` takes `&self` and returns a new owned value of the same type, and the original is not moved. A derived `clone` calls the `clone` of each field.

##### Legality Rule {#spec.ownership.clone.legality-2}

The compiler provides `Clone` for the built-in kinds of the table above: scalars and the unit type, shared references (another reference), views, arrays and records, tuples whose parts are all `Clone`, and `Copy` closures. `&var T` and a written function type are never `Clone`, and a tuple holding one is not.

<!-- rfc.py:last_reviewed 7ff6bac2f3c159c0d57a74f61abbe3fcb3000089 -->

##### Legality Rule {#spec.ownership.clone.legality-3}

`Option<T>`, `Result<T, E>` and `List<T>` are `Clone` exactly when their parameters are. A `List` clone is an independent list.

<!-- rfc.py:last_reviewed 58b51abc04d9a96abb3604f28b34f09b66dcaa36 -->

##### Legality Rule {#spec.ownership.clone.legality-4}

`struct P derives Clone` requires every field type to be `Clone`; a field that is not is an error at the field. The derived impl applies at an instantiation exactly when every field type is `Clone` there. A written `extend P: Clone` beside it overlaps and is an error (`T0015`).

##### Dynamic Semantics {#spec.ownership.clone.dynamics-1}

A derived `clone` calls the field clones in a defined order: declaration order for a struct, the payload fields of the active variant in declaration order for an enum, lexicographic label order for an anonymous record. A panic in a field clone ends the program.

<!-- rfc.py:last_reviewed 8156f9b70d40f62450255e0a8c9ce9c1af2d21b4 -->
